blurb: Division Brewing offers a selection of hand-crafted beers including light beers, IPAs, porters, stouts, and fruited sour beers. They serve thin-crust tavern style pizza, smashburgers, and comfort food. The Growl, their record store, hosts live original music most weekends supporting the local music scene.
